description: PR-1 characterization baseline for current NPC script behavior before compatibility fixes. Later stacked PRs update these cases as runtime semantics are aligned with Delphi.

cases.name: take_give_legacy_coin_token_current_item_baseline
cases.current_behavior: The localized legacy coin token is resolved as a normal item name when an item config exists; gold remains unchanged.

cases.name: checkmonmap_current_name_count_baseline
cases.current_behavior: CHECKMONMAP with two tokens is interpreted as monster-name plus count on the current MapActor.

cases.name: checkhum_current_count_only_baseline
cases.current_behavior: CHECKHUM reads only the first integer as a required count and counts players on the current MapActor.

cases.name: monclear_current_name_baseline
cases.current_behavior: MONCLEAR treats the first token as a monster name on the current MapActor.

cases.name: istakeitem_current_checkitem_baseline
cases.current_behavior: ISTAKEITEM is currently equivalent to CHECKITEM and does not consume or bind to a previously taken item.

cases.name: takecheckitem_current_name_delete_baseline
cases.current_behavior: TAKECHECKITEM currently deletes by requested item name instead of deleting the concrete item found by the preceding CHECKITEM.
